Research Engineer, Agents
OpenAI · San Francisco / Remote
Full-time

About the role
We are hiring a Research Engineer to build LLM agents that use tools, browse, and complete long-horizon tasks.
You will train and evaluate agent policies, design sandboxed tool-use environments, and ship production systems
that software engineers and researchers use every day.

Responsibilities
- Build agent runtimes, planners, and tool-calling loops on top of large language models
- Write Python services, eval harnesses, and backend APIs for experiment tracking
- Partner with research on reinforcement learning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
- Improve reliability, latency, and safety of agent products in production

Requirements
- Strong software engineering in Python (backend, distributed systems, or ML infra)
- Experience with LLMs, agents, or applied machine learning
- Comfortable owning production systems end to end

Nice to have
- TypeScript, infra, or full-stack product experience
- Published work on agents, tool-use, or reasoning
